newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ASX says studies bank merger announcement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ASX says studies bank merger announcement.

text.p: The Australian Stock Exchange said on Friday it is holding talks with the Bank of Melbourne Ltd over the timing of its announcement that it would merge with Westpac Banking Corporation.
"ASX surveillance is undertaking its usual activities in relation to Bank of Melbourne," an ASX spokesman said.
"The exchange is discussing the timing of the merger announcement with the Bank of Melbourne," he told Reuters.
The Bank of Melbourne sought a share trading halt on Wednesday afternoon ahead of an announcement the following day.
Before the trading halt, the bank's shares jumped 65 cents to A$8.80.

The Bank of Melbourne and Westpac on Thursday morning said they had agreed to combine their retail operations in Victoria as part of a A$1.435 million merger plan, prompting a further rise in Bank of Melbourne shares.
